Hi Claire — thanks for sending these over. Quick confirmation and next steps from our side: 

1) For FinOps we require either a bank-authorisation form (attached template) signed or the bank letter plus a short Voided Check / bank statement scan. Either is fine; the signed Bank Authorization Form speeds things up for ACH enrollment.

2) Micro-deposit verification is our standard flow for ACH. If you can confirm, we’ll initiate two micro-deposits (sent from Redwood) that typically post within 1-2 business days. Once you confirm the amounts, we’ll flip the vendor status to ACTIVE.

3) Invoice routing / PO mapping: please ensure each invoice contains PO# RED-4521 in the invoice header or file name so our payment system matches it automatically. If invoices come through with a different reference, please include the PO number in the email subject.

4) Wire fallback: if you want wires for the first payment, let us know and we’ll hold the ACH until we receive your signed Bank Authorization Form and clearance from finance.

I attached the Bank Authorization template and a short checklist for Remittance formatting. Marissa and Ben are looped in for scheduling the micro-deposit and final payment cadence.

Next step: Claire — confirm which document you’ll upload (signed form or voided check) and whether you want ACH now or wire for the initial pay.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
